corrected_claim: Selective and not robust. None of the six pace-vs-round-1 comparisons survives Holm correction across the 20 reported paired comparisons (judge, strict or strict-rel). At alpha=0.003 pace_cusum - r1_cusum on CUSUM k=1.5 is negative (-0.10); with the attack-only CI it was significant in the other direction, with the joint CI it is not. The pacing arms were also selected on gpt-4.1 feedback while the round-1 arms were selected on gpt-4.1-mini feedback, which favours pacing under gpt-4.1 evaluation.
